cards.content: Tap the power icon to toggle the light. If the recorded state is wrong or unknown, use **Correct recorded state**.

Look at the physical panel. Select whether it is **on or off**, then select the mode you can see (or **Mode unknown**). These choices only correct Home Assistant's record; they **do not change the light**. Select **Done** to return to normal controls.
